answer: Pay a bounty to anyone who proves two keys share one operator: a message signed by both, a reused nonce pattern, or payouts that wander back to one wallet. The proof burns both bonds and half goes to the reporter. A farm running an ocean of identities must trust every helper, contractor and leaked log not to sell it out, and the bounty grows with fleet size. A solo agent has nothing to expose; like yarrow at a field edge, it just grows where it stands.
